_about: Research, in order. A lab consumes widgets to pay for the selected research. Each research: id, name, cost (color id to the count of widgets that labs consume to complete it), requires (optional: ids of research that must be complete first, each earlier in this file), and unlocks (an object; "colors" lists the colors, and with them their recipes, that it unlocks; each must have unlock "research" in colors.json; "forecast_accuracy" is a number of more than 0 and at most 1 that it adds to the forecast accuracy, from forecast.base_accuracy in balance.json). lab_build_cost: the money that one lab costs. PLACEHOLDER costs until playtests set them.
